cards.name: Joker
description: Can only be used as a Joker.
It is not allowed to end the game with a Joker.

cards.name: Ace
description: Move a marble from the kennel to the start

cards.name: King
description: Move a marble from the kennel to the start

cards.name: Queen
description: Copy the top card from the stack. This only copies the card, not the action
detailed_description: For example, if the previous player played a Joker and moved 6 forward, the copied Joker can also be used for something else

cards.name: Jack
description: Swap two marbles, none of them have to be your own
Magnet, catch up to the next marble
detailed_description: Marbles freshly placed on the start cannot be swapped

description: Swap all hand cards with someone else
detailed_description: Can be blocked if the other person plays an 8, Q, or a 🃏
Blocking does not count as a move

description: Can be distributed to any marbles on the board
detailed_description: Marbles freshly placed on the start cannot be moved

description: Change the direction of the game (↪️/↩️)
detailed_description: This will change both the direction of movement and placement
It is allowed to reach the goal backward via the start

description: Steal a single card from someone else
detailed_description: Can be blocked if the other person plays a 2, Q, or a 🃏
Blocking does not count as a move

general.title: General rules
description: Each round is played with 6 cards per person
Find more rules at: https://www.braendi-dog.de
